column1: # nativeps5 Metal shader keys: GRAPHICS (vertex + fragment) pairs that use our own Metal translation (Kyty MSL back end) instead of KosmicKrisp's.
# HASHES AND SMALL NUMBERS ONLY, no shader code. Row: gfx vs_digest vs_spec[:cursor] ps_digest ps_spec[:cursor] kk_vs kk_fs sha256_vs sha256_fs
# variant set0 va colour_mask blend evidence. set0 = descriptor offsets binding:offset, va = vertex attributes loc:binding:fmt,
# blend = per colour attachment en:sc:dc:co:sa:da:ao:writemask:class:components. KosmicKrisp swaps a pair only when BOTH kk keys match.
# v1.1.1: 31 pairs (35 rows: some pairs serve several pipelines), each verified by a GPU differential test against KosmicKrisp's
# pair on every pipeline that uses its keys (seeds, mutant caught, determinism, NaN and out-of-bounds profiles, real vertex positions).
# evidence play2 = the same texts were played through twice with no visual issue. Fast-math OFF keys.
# v1.2.1 (xfclass): + per-GPU-class rows: mode (kyty_msl_dump --mode), class (* = every Mac, g16 = M4 family, g18 = M6 family,
# @osNN = macOS major), near-exact rule, verdict (faster on that class / shipped / slower = KosmicKrisp there), B/A on that class.
# A class row is listed only where its text was verified AND timed faster on that class (cloud M6 -> g18, laptop M4 Pro -> g16).
# A class is a GPU generation: rows timed on one model (M4 Pro, M6) apply to every Mac of that generation (M4, M4 Max, ...).
# heavypairs (USER approved 2026-11-22): rule outprec:1 = within 1 unit of the stored output precision per RT
# (here 1 f16 ulp of a packed RG16F half), D9 class, used by 8d47e44f940f0721/808d81213bdb7bac.
# meshpath (USER approved 2026-11-22): variant mesh-twin = a mesh pipeline (our mesh-stage text + the twin FS), mode meshspill = guest LDS in
# KosmicKrisp's mesh scratch (patch 0030), exact on rebased real inputs, B/A from the mesh microbench per class.
# emitmodes (USER approved 2026-11-23): rule edgeword:32 = at most 32 differing words per render target of 4096 or more,
# KosmicKrisp against itself identical, mutant caught, NaN and out-of-bounds identical, vertex stage verified alone with exact positions.
# emitmodes (USER approved 2026-11-23): rule vary:1e-3 = positions bit-exact, other vertex outputs within 1e-3 relative.
# KEY INVARIANT (ovguard, scripts/nps5lib/ovguard.py): a row is found by KosmicKrisp's key of the SPIR-V Kyty emits. While the profile gives shaders fast math
# (KYTY_GPU_ACCURACY normal|low, KYTY_FAST_MATH>=1, the vertex stage only with KYTY_FAST_MATH_VS or KYTY_FAST_MATH>=3) the guest hash of every row's
# fragment stage (and vertex stage under the vertex rule) must be in fast-math-deny.txt, or the key moves and the override silently misses.
# metal-guests.tsv maps key -> guest hash, new rows need one there.
# folship (v1.4, 2026-11-25): + 25 rows (g16 12, g17 7, g18 6) for Sky Garden foliage and skinned-bone pairs, exact (autoval VERIFIED on every
# pipeline of the key), FASTER in every timing on that class (at least 2), same modes as above.
# relabel56 (v1.4, USER 2026-11-25): the 56 D9-class rows (within 1 stored-precision unit) are labelled outprec:1, not exact, texts unchanged.
# valfix (v1.4, 2026-11-25): 110 rows removed (tests/data/valfix_dropped.tsv): level-profile validation found output differences beyond their rule on real inputs.
# shipgate (v1.4, 2026-11-25, USER): 37 rows (32 texts) removed again: shipgate FAIL on level-profile verdicts (tests/data/valfix_dropped.tsv, tier SHIPGATE).
